name: plumlayer
description: Connect agents to your Plumlayer MOSOT (cloud) and the precon harness. Create and onboard projects, read and propose claims on construction projects through the hosted MCP; log in with your Plumlayer account.

interface.shortDescription: Work with Plumlayer MOSOT projects from Codex.
interface.longDescription: Read, search, and propose grounded construction claims through the hosted Plumlayer MOSOT MCP, with the same plugin skills used by the Plumlayer precon harness.
